prompt: Create a cinematic sci-fi interior showing a single large cylindrical containment pod centered in a dark industrial laboratory corridor. The pod is made of heavy blackened metal rings and a tall rounded rectangular glass chamber, filled with warm amber fog and a soft glowing light from above and below, obscuring anything inside. The room is symmetrical, wide 16:9 composition, with dark concrete wall panels, glossy wet-looking metal floor, ceiling shadows, and cool white strip lights running along the upper side walls and low baseboards. Include one visible wall marking: a large gray number “7” on the right rear wall. Add three narrow cable or rail tracks leading from the foreground floor directly into the base of the pod. Use moody high-contrast lighting, volumetric haze, realistic textures, subtle reflections, no people, no creatures, no extra text, no watermark. The atmosphere should feel like a secret underground cryogenic facility or experimental containment chamber, photorealistic, cinematic, detailed, dark teal-gray shadows contrasted with warm orange light inside the pod.

promptZh: 创作一个电影级的科幻室内场景，展示一个位于黑暗工业实验室走廊中央的大型圆柱形收容舱。收容舱由厚重的黑化金属环和一个高大的圆角矩形玻璃舱组成，内部充满温暖的琥珀色雾气，上下方透出柔和的微光，遮蔽了内部的一切。房间呈对称式布局，采用 16:9 宽屏构图，配有深色混凝土墙板、光亮湿润的金属地面、天花板阴影，以及沿上侧墙壁和底部踢脚线延伸的冷白色条形灯。在右后方墙壁上添加一个可见的墙面标记：一个巨大的灰色数字“7”。添加三条从前景地面直接延伸至收容舱底部的狭窄电缆或轨道。使用富有情绪的高对比度照明、体积雾、逼真的纹理和微妙的反射，画面中不包含人物、生物、额外文字或水印。整体氛围应类似于秘密地下低温设施或实验收容舱，具有照片级真实感、电影质感和丰富细节，深青灰色阴影与收容舱内温暖的橙色灯光形成鲜明对比。
